text.description_html:
12" Store Front Door Extension Flush Bolt

These 12" extension flush door bolts are for aluminum store front doors. This is the most popular standard size used on store front doors. Template Size 12" - Rod 11" with 1/8" offset. Available Aluminum or Duro (Dark Bronze) finish colors. Comes complete with flush bolt assembly, extension rod and guide plate.

Flush bolts (also know as door edge bolts) are installed into the edge of the door and have a toggle lever that is moved up and down to push the attached rod and bolt into a header or threshold (footer), which locks or unlocks an inactive door. (Casting # FB-04 on some original flush bolt models).

Also available: 12" Flush Bolt - 17" Flush Bolt

Specifications: for Global TH1100-FB1 Standard Flush Bolt

  • Flush Bolt Length: 12"
  • Rod Length: 11" (1/4"-20 thread rod)
  • Offset: 1/8"
  • Spring loaded lever action
  • Supplied with nylon keeper (guide plate) and fasteners
  • Square nylon tip with Beveled Corners Fits in 1/2" (13 mm) Square or Round Strike
  • Bolt Throw: 7/8"
  • Backset: 7/8"
  • 5/8" adjustment on rod length
  • Face Plate: 15/16" Wide x 4-1/4" High with 5/32" radius corner
  • Mounting Holes: 5-7/32" Center to Center

*Sold Individually.
